notes.title: Rad Rocket Update 1.2
notes.notes:
The latest update for Rad Rocket has been released bringing it to version 1.2! This patch adds credits and streamer flair as well as some fixes.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added developer and QA credits after reaching the top.
[*] Added some flair for streamers who tried our game in the final section.
[*] Various collision fixes.
[*] Tweaked endtriggers.
[*] Geometry tweaks.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the level timer to not be rounded down to the nearest second.
[*] Fixed timed achievements to trigger larger increments (e.g. get the achievement for 10 hours when you reached the top in 5).
[*] Corrected reset save text.
[/list]

notes.title: Rad Rocket Update 1.1
notes.notes:
The latest patch for Rad Rocket has been released! This patch is aimed at fixing some bugs and improving balance. 

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] The transition between the Rocks and Mine zones has seen its difficulty decreased.
[*] A sound effects slider has been added to the options menu.
[*] The music and sound option values will now save between sessions.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused you to teleport to nowhere in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug in the tutorial where you could get stuck in geometry.
[*] Some changes to hat placements.
[*] Fixes to option screen full screen and windowed settings.
[*] Some fixes to timed achievements.
[*] Fixed text spacing in level finish window.
[*] Tweaked explosion volume
[/list]

notes.title: Rad Rocket has released!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to report that we have just officially launched our first game Rad Rocket and the game is now live!

We hope you will enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it!
